messages: Maya Chen: Quick UX review — thinking about replacing 'Stop' with 'Capture snapshot' in the playground stream so users understand the partial response becomes a static message. Thoughts? Devin Patel: 👍 I like that. Two quicks: keyboard mapping (Esc to pause?), and regenerate behavior (append vs replace snapshot). Maya Chen: Proposal: Esc toggles live/paused; regenerate appends a new message. Provide an explicit 'Replace snapshot' action if they want to overwrite. Sasha Rivera: Microcopy nit: 'Replace' is softer than 'Overwrite'. Also A11y: announce \"Snapshot captured\" via polite aria-live once, don't spam during stream. Alan Ng: Token counter placement: compact pill in message footer, right-aligned. Hover (or keyboard focus) reveals cost estimate. Keeps header tidy. Jyoti Rao: Accessibility: token pill must meet 4.5:1 contrast, be focusable, and use aria-describedby for the cost text (don't use live updates). Devin Patel: Implementation notes: debounce capture action 300ms to avoid double-capture; animate a quick flash so it's visible. Filter debounce for prompt shelf = 200ms. Playground Bot: TokenEstimator: last partial = 37 tokens; est cost $0.00018. Maya Chen: Are we ok excluding small system chips (token est bot) from exports by default? Snapshots should be included. Sasha Rivera: Yes. Add export toggle: include system metadata. Alan Ng: HTML prototype: `` + visually-hidden `Estimated cost $0.00018`. Jyoti Rao: Good — ensure the described text only reads when focused. Also define keyboard order tests for prompt shelf nav (arrows + Enter). Maya Chen: Prompt shelf: mini left drawer with pinned prompts, drag-to-pin, keyboard nav, insert shows toast \"Prompt inserted — Undo\". After insert, keep focus in composer. Devin Patel: I'll wire shortcut mapping and the undo toast. Sasha, can you draft final microcopy? Sasha Rivera: On it — will prefer 'Capture snapshot', 'Replace snapshot', 'Resume stream', and toast 'Prompt inserted — Undo'. Maya Chen: Action items: 1) Alan + Devin: capture debounce + animation + token pill prototype. 2) Jyoti: a11y acceptance criteria. 3) Sasha: microcopy. 4) Devin: prompt-shelf keyboard + undo. Alan Ng: I'll prototype token pill and capture animation by EOD. Devin Patel: I'll implement keyboard bindings and the undo toast. Jyoti Rao: I'll draft the a11y checklist and quick QA steps. Maya Chen: Thanks team — I'll update the Figma and post a spec later today. :sparkles:
